title: Task tiers
summary: Give a task four numbers, what it brings in, what it unblocks, whether it has a clock on it and how cheap it is, and BrainDog works out its priority and writes the sum as the reason.
changes: Its description says BrainDog works out a task's priority, where it said the record did. Nothing it does has changed.
